meta.notes: Part master is SIMULATED (fictional PNs). adi / cv2 / demand_class / abc from gnm.forecasting.classify.build_part_attributes on TRAINING weeks 0-77 only. stock_by_station = stock_basis (see field). RISK: risk_hours = aog_hours_hist_per_yr + residual_aog_h_per_yr, where aog_hours_hist_per_yr = P0 history AOG hours attributable to the PN (each aog_events row's hours split equally across its PNs) / 2 years, and residual_aog_h_per_yr = the optimiser's modelled expected AOG h/yr for the PN at the P2 allocation (levers.csv base_aog_hours) minus the modelled reductions of the I125 rows for that PN (allocations.json, leave-one-out), floored at 0; rotables only (residual_modelled=false for C/E, residual 0). risk_score = ln(1+risk_hours) / ln(1+max risk_hours) in [0,1]. risk_level: urgent if risk_hours >= 25, review if >= 5, else ok. ata_systems.risk = max risk_score in the chapter; ata_systems.risk_level is relative: urgent if the chapter holds >= 15% of fleet risk-hours, review if >= 7%, else ok (ASSUMED bands, DERIVED values); system_level = that rating, has_urgent_part = n_urgent > 0, status/status_label = what to print on the system pill (an OK system with urgent parts reads 'WATCH · n urgent PNs', status review). CANONICAL AOG METRICS (the same numbers on every screen, labels in aog_metric_labels): aog_h_2y / aog_events_2y = whole hours of every history AOG event listing the PN (all stations, weeks 0-103); aog_h_52w / aog_events_52w = the last 52 weeks only (W52-W103, the action centre's lookback); aog_h_52w_max_station(_id) = the worst single station in that window (equals the largest actions.json aog_hours_lookback for the PN when that station has a depletion exception). risk_hours instead splits multi-PN events equally and is per year. adi/cv2 are null when demand_class = insufficient_data (fewer than 3 non-zero training weeks: undefined). exceptions = up to 3 actions.json exceptions for the PN (most severe first, with a plain type_label): an exception's severity is planning urgency, not grounding risk, so a risk-0 PN can carry an urgent lead-time-drift action.

stock_basis: I125 recommended allocation target units: P2 stock params with the I125 changes from outputs/frontier/allocations.json. Rotables = serviceable base stock (excludes units already in the repair loop); consumables/expendables = order-up-to level S.

aog_h_2y.label: AOG h · 2-yr history · all stations
aog_h_2y.definition: Hours of every history AOG event (weeks 0-103, P0 world) that waited on this PN, all stations.

aog_h_52w.label: AOG h · last 52 wk · all stations
aog_h_52w.definition: Same events, last 52 weeks of history only (W52-W103), summed over all stations.

aog_h_52w_max_station.label: AOG h · last 52 wk · worst station
aog_h_52w_max_station.short: max AOG h at one station
aog_h_52w_max_station.definition: The largest single-station total in the last 52 weeks (station in aog_h_52w_max_station_id).

brake_note: Brakes: planned changes (wear pins), sourced at notice. Cost-per-landing contracts are not modelled. Any brake downtime shown means AUH was short and the exchange could not be arranged in time.
